description: Orders a free insured postal pack for a person at a Republic of Ireland address and returns the Bosca number. This is the real order: the request is created when you call it, and for gold lots within the postal limits the pack is posted to the address given with no further step from the person. Silver, mixed lots, bullion and lots over 2,000 euro are registered and arranged on WhatsApp instead; the response says which happened. The person gets a receipt email with a single-use cancel link. Before calling: have the person's name, full address with Eircode, email, phone, what they are sending (gold, silver or mixed) with a rough description and rough value, their agreement to be contacted, and their agreement to the terms statement in accepts_terms. Explain the process first (get_postal_pack_info): items weighed and XRF tested on camera, an itemised offer at the live published rate on the day of testing (no payout is promised), free tracked return if they decline, insured in transit up to 2,000 euro, paid by bank transfer the same day they accept, one photo ID checked before payment. Lots worth more than 1,000 euro can be brought to us in person in Dublin, by appointment, and tested while you watch; message us on WhatsApp to arrange a time. Smaller lots go by post. Do not collect or pass ID documents. Errors name the field to fix.

accepts_terms.description: Must be true, and only after the person has agreed to this statement, which you read to them: "I am 18 or over and I own the items I will send, or am authorised to sell them. I accept the Liffey Metals Postal Selling Terms and Seller Agreement (liffeymetals.com/terms/postal and liffeymetals.com/legal/seller-agreement). I understand that if I decline the offer my items are returned free, and that a postage deduction applies only as those terms describe."

address_line1.description: House or apartment and street, or townland

agent.description: Optional: the name of the assistant or model making the request, recorded with the lead

consent_contact.description: Must be true: the person agrees to be emailed about the pack and contacted about their items

county.description: County in the Republic of Ireland, e.g. Cork, Mayo, Dublin (Northern Ireland addresses are refused with the alternative)

eircode.description: The person's Eircode, 7 characters, e.g. D02 X285 (finder.eircode.ie)

email.description: The person's own email: the receipt, the offer and every update go there

estimated_value_eur.description: Rough total value in euro; ask for it. It sets the value band on the request and the route: gold up to 2,000 euro goes straight to a pack, lots over 2,000 euro are arranged on WhatsApp, and under 300 euro there is no pack. Left out, the lot is recorded in the 300 to 500 euro band.

metal_type.description: What they are sending: gold, silver or mixed

name.description: The person's full name, as it should appear on the pack

phone.description: Phone number, a mobile preferred, e.g. 087 123 4567 or +353 87 123 4567

rough_description.description: A rough description of the items, e.g. 'two 9ct rings and a broken 18ct chain, about 12 g'

source_of_items.description: Optional: where the items came from, if the person said; defaults to other

name: request_postal_pack
title: Order a free postal pack (Bosca) for the user
